summary: The city page could not be read directly today: cityofainsworth.com answered with a Cloudflare block. Its indexed text and the 2026-10-10 direct read agree: $10 for a hookup site, $7 for tents, $5 dump, open April through October weather permitting, first-come with no reservations. Season, booking and fees are written from that. Camper reports dispute the city's 'water & electric'. They describe ~8 unmarked 20/30 A pedestals with no water at the sites, only spigots in the park. Pin OK. Not waterfront.
